purpose: ERP 스타일 UI 재구성을 위한 화면 후보. 실제 앱 구현 전 디자인 검토용.
status: selected as layout references; detailed UI design under review
data_notice: 화면 안의 본문·상태·검토 목록은 배치용 예시이며 운영 결과나 적합성 판정이 아닙니다. 실제 구현에서는 저장소 원문과 실제 조회 결과를 표시해야 합니다.

variants.title: 문서대장 중심형
variants.focus: 문서 유형별 검색·조회와 상세 정보 확인
variants.tradeoff: 대량 목록 작업에 적합하며 여러 업무의 시작점은 상대적으로 덜 강조됩니다.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished, realistic Korean-language desktop ERP application screen concept, landscape 16:10, at least 1920 pixels wide. This is a complete flat front-facing app screenshot for design review, NOT a photograph, laptop mockup, website landing page or infographic. Product: "iso-agent", ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system, sample organization "에이아이듀". Audience: document and AI governance managers. Preserve these existing modules, renaming technical labels for human readability: 문서관리, 기록관리, 지식 검토, 요구사항 추적, 영향평가 초안, 지식 위키, 관리 설정. Settings contains seed import, not a main technical task. Current app is a simple document/records/facts/wiki tool; all views here are PROPOSED designs, not claims of implemented functionality or live operational results. Must display small readable "화면 시안 · 예시 데이터" in the footer and "에이아이듀 · 데모" in header. The separation of requirements/manuals, procedures, guidance, blank forms, and actual execution records matters. NO automatic compliance judgement, certification score, fabricated activity chart, revenue metrics, sales, accounting, HR features or unrelated ERP domains.
Visual requirements: beautiful highly disciplined enterprise product design, legible Korean sans-serif like Pretendard, crisp professional typography, strong grid alignment, fine 1px separators, 4-6px corner radii, compact but readable table density, purposeful clear hierarchy. No giant rounded cards, gradients, glass, decorative illustration, garbled prose, marketing copy, giant title, purple styling, or excessive ornamental icons. All UI is practical to implement as code-native HTML/CSS text, controls and reusable components. Accurate readable Korean. Use document identifiers with restrained monospace. Footer always visible, complete uncropped screen. Main hierarchy grounded in real documents:
AIDU-AIM-01-03 / 조직의 상황 / 매뉴얼
AIDU-AIM-01-04 / 리더십 / 매뉴얼
AIDU-AIM-01-05 / 기획 / 매뉴얼
AIDU-AIM-01-07 / 운용 / 매뉴얼
AIDU-AIP-06-01 / 리스크 관리 / 절차서
AIDU-AIP-06-02 / 시스템 영향평가 / 절차서
AIDU-AIG-08-01 / 인공지능경영활동관리규정 / 지침서
AIDU-AIP-06-02-F01 / 영향평가 계획·범위서 / 양식
AIDU-AIP-06-02-F02 / 영향평가서 / 양식.
Never conflate a form with a completed record. Any numbers or statuses must be clearly sample UI data.
Variant A: "문서대장 중심형", traditional mature ERP information architecture reinterpreted with modern typography. Navy #15283f top global application bar, 54px, brand left, organization center-right, functional user "인공지능안전관리자" at right. Beneath, 220px pale blue-grey left navigation, narrow compact workspace-tab strip, and full-width white main content. Blue #2563eb primary accent, #f3f5f8 light grey canvas, dark slate text. Very restrained shadow.
Left menu groups: "경영시스템" with 문서관리 selected, 기록관리; "지식·평가" with 지식 검토, 요구사항 추적, 영향평가 초안, 지식 위키; bottom 관리 설정. At bottom of sidebar show "ISO/IEC 42001".
Workspace tabs: "문서대장" active, "시스템 영향평가", "요구사항 추적", small close icons. Breadcrumb "경영시스템 / 문서관리", main heading "문서대장". On right of heading two compact actions "목록 내보내기" outlined and "문서 동기화" blue.
A shallow, rectangular filter band with labels "문서 유형" dropdown "전체", "검색어" text field placeholder "문서번호 또는 제목", "조회" blue and "초기화" subtle. Below filter, flat category tabs "전체", "매뉴얼", "절차서", "지침서", "양식". Document table occupies main area, 9 visible rows with sample listed above, columns checkbox, 문서번호, 문서명, 유형, 연결 요구사항, 보기. Rows medium compact 48px, column header light grey. Selected row AIDU-AIP-06-02 highlighted pale blue with left blue rule, linked requirements "6.1.4 · 8.4", and "원문" link at end. Other relationships plausible "4.1 · 4.2", "5.1 · 5.2", "6.1", "8.1". Avoid invented version or approval fields.
Bottom persistent horizontal detail pane under table: selected "시스템 영향평가" with tabs "기본정보", "연결 문서", "원문". Visible metadata row 문서번호 AIDU-AIP-06-02, 문서 유형 절차서, 담당 역할 인공지능안전관리자; below two simple text links "상위 매뉴얼 · 기획" and "관련 양식 · 영향평가 계획·범위서". A small outline button "상세 열기" right. Show complete screen with readable footer. A high-utility desktop table-first ERP, professionally refined. No need to print variant letter inside the app.

variants.title: 업무 포털형
variants.tradeoff: 업무 시작이 쉽고 여유로운 구성이나 한 번에 보이는 목록은 적습니다.

Variant B: "업무 포털형", contemporary approachable ERP module portal, white header and dark teal #163c3b left navigation, emerald teal #147d69 accent, true white and cool light grey work surfaces. Light, welcoming but serious product design. Use mostly open lists and bands; NO generic grid of metric cards. Brand in top left sidebar "iso-agent". Sidebar 220px, navigation has "업무 홈" selected plus existing modules grouped exactly as in shared brief. White top header breadcrumb "에이아이듀 / 경영시스템", global search field "문서·기록·요구사항 검색", user functional role "인공지능안전관리자". Secondary open workspace tabs "업무 홈", "문서대장", "시스템 영향평가".
Main heading "업무 홈" in restrained 28px font, subtitle "문서와 근거를 연결하고, 필요한 검토를 시작하세요." A wide, shallow white action band below shows three equal text links with slim line icons and vertical separators: "문서 찾아보기" / "요구사항 추적" / "영향평가 초안". No counts and no large KPI cards.
Main layout 2/3 left, 1/3 right with generous but controlled 24px gutters. Left main section "최근 확인한 문서" as a disciplined enterprise table: columns 문서번호, 문서명, 유형, with 5 real sample documents from shared brief; at top link "문서대장 전체 보기". Below this section a flat "지식 검토함" list with two clearly marked sample draft knowledge relations: "시스템 영향평가 → 영향평가 계획·범위서", small caption "양식 연결 · 검토 대기", outlined "검토하기" button; and "리스크 관리 → 기획", caption "요구사항 연결 · 검토 대기". No fabricated operational assertions.
Right: single vertically divided workspace area headed "영향평가 작업", showing "Edu Score", "초안", an understated three-step horizontal line "변경 내용 → 근거 확인 → 초안 생성", and compact field labeled "변경 내용" with text "평가 대상과 변경 사항을 입력하세요", teal action "영향평가 시작". Below a separate simple "바로 찾는 지식" list: "시스템 영향평가", "리스크 관리", "인공지능경영방침", each a right chevron, and small lower note "원문 근거와 함께 확인". At bottom open horizontal document-category navigation "매뉴얼 / 절차서 / 지침서 / 양식 / 기록" with tiny distinct category icons, all readable, no flashy dashboard chart. Carefully balanced white space, everything fits one viewport. The design should be clearly structurally different from a register table or three-column review editor.

variants.title: 검토 작업대형
variants.focus: 검토 목록·원문·연결 근거를 한 화면에 배치
variants.tradeoff: 근거 대조에 적합하며 넓은 데스크톱 화면에 유리합니다.

Variant C: "검토 작업대형", focused ERP review workbench for assessing an extracted knowledge relationship against original document text. A precise three-pane enterprise application, compact white header, graphite #253044 slim left icon rail 64px, cobalt #315bcc action accent, white content, #edf0f4 separators, restrained amber for "검토 대기". No visualized graph spaghetti, no chart, no auto-approval or compliance score. Real readable Korean source document text only in short paragraphs.
Top brand "iso-agent"; workspace tabs "문서대장" and selected "지식 검토"; organization "에이아이듀 · 데모"; user "기술책임자". Secondary main toolbar heading "지식 검토", small breadcrumb "문서 지식 / 연결 검토", dropdown "검토 대기", search "문서번호·제목 검색".
Three panes fill almost entire viewport:
LEFT 300px review queue, heading "검토할 연결", label "예시 목록", list entries: selected "시스템 영향평가" with ID AIDU-AIP-06-02 and subtext "양식 연결 확인", second "리스크 관리" ID AIDU-AIP-06-01 and subtext "요구사항 연결 확인", third "인공지능경영활동관리규정" ID AIDU-AIG-08-01 subtext "절차서 연결 확인". Each uses compact real text, left selected blue stripe, subtle bottom borders.
CENTER widest, around 650px: document reading area, top label "원문" and outline button "원문 열기", title "시스템 영향평가", document ID, tabs "본문" selected, "연결 문서", "출처". Elegant readable paper-like reading surface without big shadow. Visible headings "1 목적", brief text "AI 시스템이 개인·집단·사회에 미치는 잠재적 영향을 평가하고, 그 결과를 설계·운영에 반영한다." This paragraph should be tagged subtly as "요약". Then heading "4.1 개시·범위·평가 계획". Highlight ONE exact short quote in pale yellow with small line-reference marker: "인공지능안전관리자는 영향평가 계획·범위서(F01)에 다음 사항을 정하고 기술책임자의 승인을 받아야 한다." Below heading "연결된 양식" and a simple document link "AIDU-AIP-06-02-F01 · 영향평가 계획·범위서". No long garbled dense body copy.
RIGHT 360px clean inspector: heading "지식 연결 검토" and amber text "검토 대기". Form-like vertical fields: "대상 문서" → "시스템 영향평가", "연결 관계" → "기록 양식을 요구함", "연결 양식" → "영향평가 계획·범위서", "근거 위치" → "AIDU-AIP-06-02 / 4.1.2". Neutral explanatory note "양식 연결을 검토하는 화면입니다. 기록의 수행 여부는 별도로 확인합니다." Then bordered comment field "검토 의견" placeholder "근거와 검토 의견을 입력하세요". Sticky bottom action group outlined "보류" and solid blue "연결 승인". Whole viewport footer "화면 시안 · 예시 데이터", secondary explanatory text "원문 근거 기반 검토". Make left queue, document middle, inspector right sharply distinct, usable and beautifully typeset. Full screen, no cropped elements.

recommendation: 사용자 선택: A를 공통 틀로 적용하고 B를 주 목적의 업무 홈으로 구성하며 C를 검토 상세에 적용한다.
